children: OpenEye is thrilled to announce advanced new innovations to OpenEye Web Services (OWS) through the addition of AI-powered visual search and alerting, helping enhance operations for modern enterprise organizations.
As a core part of the OWS AI Analytics suite,
AI Visual Search
and
AI Visual Check

offer businesses innovative and intuitive tools built to improve operations and fortify security. Users can surface video quickly and automate procedures through natural-language inputs, all within an intelligent cloud video solution. With these integral platform functionalities, OpenEye provides a premium video offering that supports the businesses of its customers and helps them scale their workflows to enable greater future growth.

OpenEye founder and CEO Rick Sheppard said, “These AI-powered capabilities mark a significant step forward in transforming video into a source of actionable intelligence for our customers—going beyond traditional security. With natural language search and automated alerts on visual changes, we’re saving businesses time and eliminating manual effort with trusted, proactive solutions that help our customers operate more effectively every day.”
AI Visual Search
AI Visual Search in OWS

locates specific moments in video footage via simple user-input descriptions. Users can type in a natural-language query, such as "A person carrying a box in the lobby yesterday afternoon," and the system will quickly surface the most relevant results across cameras.
AI Visual Check
Designed to automate monitoring of business operations, safety protocols, and compliance across multiple locations,
AI Visual Check

analyzes images to detect and alert on real business and safety issues across locations. This includes blocked fire exits, out-of-stock shelves, or unattended security posts, to reduce reliance on manual oversight or walkthroughs, enable faster resolution, and free up resources across modern enterprises.
Explore AI Visual Search and AI Visual Check Today

AI Visual Search and AI Visual Check represent a pivotal step forward for the OWS platform as OpenEye continues equipping businesses with intelligent surveillance solutions. These intuitive video analytics can be effortlessly incorporated into existing company workflows to provide an overall more impactful system experience. Businesses can leverage powerful AI capabilities throughout their organization to unlock new avenues towards optimizing workflows across departments, helping drive greater revenue and strengthen security.

About OpenEye

OpenEye, an Alarm.com company (Nasdaq: ALRM), creates intelligent cloud video solutions that make people safer and organizations stronger. Offering AI-powered capabilities through a flexible and scalable platform, OpenEye Web Services (OWS) helps businesses turn video into actionable insights, moving reactive security to proactive operations, reduced risk, and measurable ROI. Unlock business intelligence with an open, intelligent, and trusted cloud video platform.
